introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: Welcome to STRAŦUM! This guide provides best practices for marketing agencies using the platform to manage multiple clients efficiently while delivering exceptional results through AI-powered intelligence.

clientOnboarding.title: Client Onboarding Strategy

steps.addClient: Add Client: Navigate to "Add Your First Client" button on the dashboard
steps.strategicFoundation: Strategic Foundation: Run Business Strategy Agent to establish strategic frameworks
steps.customerInsights: Customer Insights: Generate 3-5 personas using Persona Agent
steps.marketingDirection: Marketing Direction: Create initial marketing strategy with Marketing Strategy Agent

clientOnboarding.proTipContent: Don't try to gather everything upfront - let AI agents learn progressively through conversations. Each interaction builds context automatically.

dataProtection.title: Your Client Data is Protected
dataProtection.description: STRAŦUM keeps each client's data completely separate and secure. Client A will never see Client B's information, and vice versa. This protection is built into the platform at the database level.

doItems.useSelector: Use the client selector to switch between clients
doItems.doubleCheck: Double-check you're in the right client workspace
doItems.downloadRegularly: Download important strategies and content regularly
doItems.lookForBadge: Look for the "Data Protected" badge for peace of mind

dontItems.copySensitive: Copy sensitive information between client workspaces
dontItems.shareLogin: Share your login with team members (invite them instead)
dontItems.exportWithoutPermission: Export client data without their permission

dataProtection.alphaTipContent: We recommend downloading valuable strategies and content as you create them. Use the export buttons in the Content Agent (Word, PDF, Google Docs) and the Outputs Hub. Think of it like saving your work in a document — always a good habit!

teamRoles.title: Team Collaboration & Roles
teamRoles.description: STRAŦUM offers 10 different team roles for agencies, so each person only sees what they need for their job:

agencyAdmin.title: Agency Admin
agencyAdmin.description: All client management, no billing access

clientViewer.title: Client Viewer
clientViewer.description: Read-only access to assigned client data

teamRoles.inviteInstructions: How to invite team members: Click your profile picture → Settings → Team Management. Assign roles based on what each person actually does, not their job title or seniority. Give people access to what they need - nothing more, nothing less.

aiWorkflow.title: AI Agent Workflow
aiWorkflow.description: For new clients, follow this strategic sequence:

steps.step1: Business Strategy Agent - Establish frameworks (SWOT, Porter's Five Forces)
steps.step2: Persona Agent - Create 3-5 detailed customer personas
steps.step3: Marketing Strategy Agent - Develop go-to-market strategy

steps.step1: Content Agent - Generate content calendar and initial assets
steps.step2: Campaign Planning Agent - Map out multi-channel campaigns
steps.step3: Competitive Intelligence Agent - Analyze market positioning

steps.step1: Performance Intelligence Agent - Track ROI, KPIs, and identify quick wins
steps.step2: Client Success Agent - Monitor client health and retention

aiWorkflow.crossAgentContent: STRAŦUM agents share context automatically. Personas feed into content generation, strategies inform campaigns, and performance data triggers optimization insights. Trust the system's data flow.

lifecycleSteps.planning: Planning: Use Marketing Strategy Agent to define objectives and budget (70-20-10 rule)
lifecycleSteps.content: Content Creation: Content Agent provides 9 tools (SEO blog, social media, email campaigns, etc.)
lifecycleSteps.execution: Execution Tracking: Mark one strategy as "Active" per campaign, upload performance data via CSV
lifecycleSteps.optimization: Optimization: Use Performance Intelligence Agent for quick wins insights and Budget Optimizer for allocation recommendations

multiClientItems.selector: Client selector in top navigation for quick switching
multiClientItems.outputsHub: Outputs Hub shows all AI-generated content across clients
multiClientItems.bulkOperations: Bulk operations for archiving old campaigns
